reports.auto_export_desc: Daily/monthly summaries, date filters, automatic calculations, and exports have not been approved. The report list presents them as concepts, not final features.

reminders.open_decisions_title: Reminder aspects that still need decisions
reminders.page_desc: Manage reminders as records: enter a name, description, deadline, and status. No automatic triggers or notifications are sent.

reminders.trigger_repeat_desc: Should reminders trigger on the deadline date only, a few days before, or repeat every day until marked complete?
reminders.timezone_desc: Time reference has not been set (server time, browser time, or user timezone). The prototype shows dates as-is without conversion.
reminders.task_link_desc: Reminders currently stand alone and are not linked to task data. A linking column would be needed in the database schema.
reminders.status_meaning_desc: The exact meaning of \u201cActive\u201d, \u201cInactive\u201d, and \u201cCompleted\u201d is not final, including whether the system automatically changes status when a deadline passes. The prototype does not change status automatically.
reminders.delivery_desc: Active notifications are listed as out of scope and also referred to as \u201cIn-app notification\u201d. This conflict is recorded as an open decision; automatic notifications are not yet available.
